stem:
The diagram shows a rectangle covered by $1$ cm by $1$ cm unit squares. Tara counts $4$ squares along the length and $3$ along the width.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: The area is $12$ square centimetres, because $4\times 3$ unit squares fill the rectangle.
The area is $1$ square centimetre, because that is the size of one unit square.
The area is $7$ cm, by adding $4$ and $3$ and dropping square units.
The area is $4$ square centimetres, because $4$ is the longer side printed on the card.

teacher.key_rationale: Area is length times width in square units: 4×3=12 cm². Calling one unit square the area swaps the measure. Adding sides drops square units. Picking the printed 4 captures a surface number.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source net grid as a 4-by-3 rectangle of unit squares.
